route.name: Brisbane
route.sub: 2 nights (from Dec 16) + 1 night Dec 22 · Hyatt Regency Brisbane

route.name: Moreton Island
route.sub: 4 nights · Tangalooma Island Resort, Family Suite · own 4WD

blocks.title: Arrive FLL Terminal 3 — JetBlue bag drop
blocks.detail:
• 2 hrs ahead of a domestic flight — holiday-week crowds, family of 4, 3 checked bags.
• Bags are tagged to LAX only: this is a separate ticket from the Qantas flight.
• JetBlue bag drop closes 40 min before departure.
• Hats, sun shirts and sunscreen in the carry-ons — landing day is a full day out in Brisbane.
blocks.notes:
• Award fares don't include a checked bag: 3 bags × $49 (peak) = $147 — estimated; $39 per bag if Dec 15 is off-peak.
• Prepay in the app; bags added within 24 hrs of departure cost $10 more each.
blocks.flag: Departs Fort Lauderdale, not Miami — plan the drive up and parking.

blocks.title: TSA, then lunch to go — FLL Terminal 3
blocks.detail:
• Buy lunch after security to eat on the plane — the flight spans lunchtime and JetBlue only sells snack boxes.
• Refill water bottles at the gate.
blocks.notes: • ~$50 for 2 adult + 2 kids' grab-and-go meals — estimated.

blocks.title: At the gate — boarding
blocks.detail:
• Bathroom stop before boarding.
• Boarding starts ~30–40 min before departure.

blocks.title: JetBlue B6201 - FLL → LAX - Nonstop - 5h53m
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:00 PM Eastern, lands 2:53 PM Pacific (3 hrs behind Florida).
• Economy, 4 passengers.
• Lunch on board. Kids: a nap of 45 min max — the long sleep happens on the Qantas flight.
• All LAX times below are Pacific.
blocks.notes:
• Not booked.
• Seen on seats.aero (Oct 2026 search): 16,300 TrueBlue pts + $5.60 per person → 65,200 pts + $22.40 for four. Class U, 9 seats.
• Same flight via United MileagePlus: 35,000 pts + $5.60 per person.
• Separate ticket from the Qantas leg.
blocks.flag:
If this flight cancels or runs very late, rebook the same day: American MIA → LAX nonstops at ~1:45 PM and ~3:40 PM Eastern still make Qantas check-in (closes 8:45 PM Pacific).
Qantas isn't responsible for a missed connection on a separate ticket — get travel insurance that covers missed connections.

blocks.title: Land LAX — deplane, Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• JetBlue uses Terminal 1 at LAX — confirm the week before.
• Domestic arrival: no immigration or customs.
• Bathroom stop on the way to baggage claim.

blocks.title: Baggage claim — Terminal 1
blocks.detail:
• Collect all 3 checked bags.
• Grab a luggage cart at claim.
blocks.notes: • Luggage cart ~$6 — estimated.

blocks.title: Terminal 1 → Tom Bradley International Terminal
blocks.detail:
• Stay landside — exit claim and walk west along the Upper/Departures Level sidewalk past Terminals 2 and 3 to Tom Bradley (~0.6 mi, ~20 min with a cart and kids).
• Alternative: the free LAX inter-terminal shuttle from the Lower/Arrivals Level island outside Terminal 1.
• Qantas check-in is Aisle B inside Tom Bradley.

blocks.title: Qantas check-in and bag drop — Tom Bradley, Aisle B
blocks.detail:
• Counters B23–32 open 3:30 PM; check-in closes 60 min before departure (8:45 PM).
• Bags tagged through to Brisbane.
• Economy allowance: 2 bags × 23 kg (50 lb) per person — confirm on the booking.
• Have passports and the Australian ETA confirmations ready.
• Online check-in opens 24 hrs before departure.

blocks.title: TSA security — Tom Bradley
blocks.detail: • Holiday-week evening rush at Tom Bradley — 35 min allowed.

blocks.title: Tom Bradley airside — settle in near the gate
blocks.detail:
• No lounge access on an economy ticket — find a table in the main hall after security.
• Charge devices; download shows for the flight.
• Buy water bottles for the flight.

blocks.title: Dinner — Tom Bradley food hall (after security)
blocks.detail:
• The main meal before the flight, so everyone can skip the onboard dinner and sleep right after takeoff.
• Light on sugar and caffeine.
blocks.notes: • ~$80 for 2 adult mains + 2 kids' meals at airport prices — estimated; menus not checked.

blocks.title: Wind down — pajamas, teeth, quiet time
blocks.detail:
• Kids change into pajamas and brush teeth in the restroom.
• Dim screens, quiet activities — no new movies started.

blocks.title: Walk to the gate and board
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts ~60 min before departure; the gate closes 20 min before.
• Last bathroom stop at the gate.

blocks.title: Qantas QF16 - LAX → BNE - Nonstop - ~14h05m
blocks.detail:
• Economy, 4 passengers. Boeing 787-9.
• Departs 9:45 PM Pacific = 3:45 PM Thursday in Brisbane.
• Crosses the International Date Line — Thursday Dec 16 disappears in flight.
• Lands 5:50 AM Friday Dec 17, Brisbane time (AEST, UTC+10, no daylight saving; 18 hrs ahead of LA, 15 hrs ahead of Florida).
blocks.notes:
• Not booked. Atmos economy on QF16 shows on seats.aero at 42,500 pts + $49.60 per person (Nov 2026 – Mar 2027 dates) → 170,000 pts + $198.40 for four.
• Same flight via Air France/KLM Flying Blue: 38,500 + ~$123 per person.
• Award space for Dec 15, 2027 opens roughly Dec 2026–Jan 2027.

SLEEP PLAN (Brisbane time in brackets):
• Skip the dinner service — eat in the terminal before boarding.
• Pajamas on, neck pillows, eye masks, earplugs, kids' headphones; lights out once the seatbelt sign is off (~10:30 PM LA / 4:30 PM BNE).
• Expect kids ~6–8 hrs sleep, adults ~3–5 hrs in economy seats.
• Whoever wakes first takes the kids' screens/snacks so the other parent keeps sleeping.
• Breakfast ~90 min before landing (~4:15 AM BNE); no more sleep after it. Shades up and screens on so everyone is awake for landing.
blocks.flag:
Apply for each traveller's Australian ETA (official 'Australian ETA' app) before departure — not issued on arrival.
Confirm the exact flight number, times and aircraft when Dec 15, 2027 award space opens.

days.title: Arrive Brisbane — Kangaroo Point Cliffs, river cruise, Riverbar dinner

blocks.title: Arrive BNE — immigration, bags, biosecurity
blocks.detail:
• SmartGate for adult US e-passports; kids use the staffed lane with a parent.
• Declare any food — don't carry fruit or snacks off the plane.
• 75 min gate-to-curb for a family with checked bags, incl. a bathroom stop.

blocks.title: Walk to the taxi rank — International terminal, Arrivals level
blocks.detail:
• From: arrivals hall → follow the 'Taxi' signs to the rank outside.
• Ask the marshal for a Maxi Taxi (4 people + 3 checked bags).

blocks.title: Maxi Taxi BNE International → Hyatt Regency Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• ~20 km via Airport Link/Inner City Bypass; 25–30 min on a Friday morning.
• No rental car needed in Brisbane anymore — the 4WD is collected tomorrow.
• Queensland taxis have a child-restraint exemption when no seat is fitted — the kids ride in the back.
blocks.notes:
• ~AUD 70 incl. airport pickup fee and toll — estimated.
• = USD ~46.

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Brisbane — bell desk takes the bags
blocks.detail:
• 33 Burnett Lane (Queen St Mall), middle of the CBD. Category 3 World of Hyatt.
• Room is booked from Thu Dec 16, so it's ready on arrival — bags go straight up.
• Ask for the Deluxe Room, Multiple Beds (sleeps 4) or connecting rooms.
• You come back for one more night on Wed Dec 22.
blocks.nights: 2 nights (Thu Dec 16 – Sat Dec 18) + 1 night Wed Dec 22
blocks.roomType: Standard room (or standard suite if available)
blocks.notes:
• Modeled at 12,000 pts/night × 2 = 24,000 (the Dec 16 night guarantees the room on arrival).
• Dec 22 night: another 12,000 pts (on the Dec 22 block).
• Globalist: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids; free valet on an award stay.
blocks.flag: Ask the hotel to hold your big suitcases Sat Dec 18 → Wed Dec 22 so you only take island bags to Moreton.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Straight down after dropping the bags.
• Weekday breakfast 6:30–10:00 AM.
• Last meal until dinner — no lunch stop today.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids included. AUD 0.

blocks.title: Back up to the room
blocks.detail: • Elevator, unpack the essentials.

blocks.title: Showers and change
blocks.detail: • 45 min for four people after a ~30-hour door-to-door journey.

blocks.title: Downtime in the room — no naps
blocks.detail:
• Feet up, unpack, charge devices.
• Curtains open — daylight helps reset body clocks.

blocks.title: Sunscreen, hats, day bag
blocks.detail:
• UV is Extreme by midday.
• Day bag: water bottles and snacks — no lunch stop until dinner at 5.

blocks.title: Walk to the City Botanic Gardens
blocks.detail: • ~800 m via Albert St to the Alice St gate.

blocks.title: City Botanic Gardens — riverside paths + playground
blocks.detail:
• A full hour here: shaded paths under giant figs, mangrove boardwalk, playground.
• Morning daylight helps reset body clocks — stay outside, no naps today.
• The Kangaroo Point Green Bridge starts at the Alice/Edward St corner of the gardens.

blocks.title: Cross the Kangaroo Point Green Bridge
blocks.detail:
• 470 m walking/cycling bridge over the river (opened Dec 2024).
• Story Bridge and Kangaroo Point Cliffs ahead.

blocks.title: Kangaroo Point Cliffs lookout
blocks.detail:
• The best free view of the city skyline and the river bend.
• Little shade at the top — keep it short.

blocks.title: Riverwalk to South Bank
blocks.detail:
• ~1.5–2 km, flat, along the riverfront past the Maritime Museum.
• 40 min at kid pace, including a water stop.

blocks.title: Wheel of Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• Enclosed, air-conditioned gondolas; ~15-min ride, 60 m up over South Bank.
• 40 min allowed for the queue.
blocks.notes:
ESTIMATE (third-party listing, not the operator's own page):
• ~AUD 20 adult × 2 + ~AUD 14 child × 2 = AUD 68 ≈ USD 44.
• Confirm current price and hours.

blocks.title: Walk to the Cultural Centre pontoon and board
blocks.detail:
• Public pontoon in front of the Queensland Museum / art gallery, South Bank boardwalk.
• Bathroom stop before boarding.

blocks.title: River City Cruises — Mid-Afternoon Sightseeing Cruise (anchor)
blocks.detail:
• 90 min, seated and covered, with commentary; licensed bar on board.
• Downriver past Kangaroo Point Cliffs, under the Story Bridge, out to New Farm and the Powerhouse.
blocks.notes:
VERIFIED (Visit Brisbane listing):
• Family (2 adults + 2 children 5–14) AUD 120 ≈ USD 78.
• Adult AUD 49, child AUD 22.
• Departs the Cultural Centre Public Pontoon, South Bank.
blocks.flag: Confirm the 2:30 PM departure runs on Fridays in December, then book.

blocks.title: CityCat South Bank → Riverside
blocks.detail:
• ~600 m walk along the boardwalk to the South Bank CityCat terminal.
• Flat 50-cent fare per person (tap on with a card or phone).
• Short ride upriver past the CBD; 40 min absorbs one missed boat.

blocks.title: Riverfront boardwalk toward the Story Bridge
blocks.detail: • Eagle St riverwalk, right outside the restaurant.

blocks.title: Dinner — Riverbar & Kitchen, Eagle St
blocks.detail:
• Casual, on the river at Riparian Plaza (71 Eagle St), Story Bridge in view.
• Fish & chips, burgers, pizza, pasta; real kids' menu (12 and under).
• Kitchen open 11:30 AM–9:30 PM on Fridays — book a deck table for 5:00.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Oct 2026):
• Beer-battered fish & chips AUD 35
• Riverbar cheeseburger with chips AUD 30
• 2 kids' meals (fish & chips / cheeseburger / ham & pineapple pizza / fettuccine) AUD 15 each
• = AUD 95 ≈ USD 62.
• Australian menu prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail: • ~700 m up Creek St / Queen St.

blocks.title: Baths, pajamas — lights out by 7:15 PM
blocks.detail:
• Tomorrow: breakfast 7:00 AM, taxi to the 4WD depot at 7:55.
• Tonight: pack one island bag per person; big suitcases stay with the hotel.

days.title: Collect the 4WD, groceries, Micat to Moreton Island, dolphin feeding

blocks.title: Leave the big suitcases with the bell desk
blocks.detail:
• Take only island bags: swimwear, rash guards, hats, sunscreen, kids' snorkel masks, water shoes, a warm layer.
• The hotel holds the rest until you're back Wed Dec 22.
blocks.flag: Confirm luggage storage between stays with the hotel when booking.

blocks.title: Breakfast — Lennons (in the hotel)
blocks.detail:
• Globalist breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids.
• Eat well — next proper meal is a late lunch snack on the ferry.
blocks.notes: • Globalist benefit: AUD 0.
blocks.flag: Confirm Saturday breakfast opening time (weekday is 6:30 AM).

blocks.title: Check out, taxi from the hotel entrance
blocks.detail: • Island bags only.

blocks.title: Taxi Hyatt Regency → Wongai 4WD Hire, Geebung
blocks.detail:
• To: 91 Basalt Street, Geebung (northern suburbs).
• ~12 km, 20–25 min on a Saturday morning.
blocks.notes:
• ~AUD 40 — estimated.
• = USD ~26.

blocks.title: Collect the 4WD — Wongai 4WD Hire
blocks.detail:
• Toyota LandCruiser Prado 120 (seats up to 7), Moreton Island package.
• Collection from 8:00 AM, 7 days.
• Safety briefing (mandatory for all drivers), maps, tide times.
• $5,000 refundable bond on a physical credit card.
• Ask them to show tyre deflation/reinflation and the recovery gear.
blocks.notes:
• Package includes the Moreton Island vehicle access permit (verified, Wongai listing).
• Price is quote-only: 'from AUD 690' for the 2-day minimum (verified). Modeled at ~AUD 250/day × 6 calendar days (Sat Dec 18 – Thu Dec 23) = ~AUD 1,500 — estimated.
• = USD ~975. Fuel not included; ferry not included.
• Option: collect the evening before for AUD 120 (verified) if you'd rather catch the 8:00 AM ferry.
blocks.flag: Booster seat: Queensland law requires an approved restraint for kids under 7 — ask Wongai for one or bring a travel booster.

blocks.title: Drive to BCF Virginia
blocks.detail:
• To: BCF, 2043 Sandgate Rd, Virginia — ~4 km, 10 min.
• First drive on the left: the passenger navigates.

blocks.title: BCF — cooler, ice and sand boards
blocks.detail:
• Opens 8:00 AM Saturdays.
• Buy: a medium cooler (esky), ice bricks/bags, 2 sand toboggans or sand boards (+ wax), a cheap tyre-pressure gauge if Wongai doesn't supply one.
• No board hire found on the island — buy them here.
blocks.notes:
• ~AUD 110 for cooler + ice + 2 boards — estimated (stock not checked).
• = USD ~72.
blocks.flag: Call BCF Virginia (+61 7 3216 5077) the week before to check they stock sand boards; Anaconda Chermside is the backup.

blocks.title: Drive to Woolworths Taigum
blocks.detail: • To: Woolworths, 217 Beams Rd, Taigum — ~6 km, 10 min.

blocks.title: Groceries — Woolworths Taigum
blocks.detail:
• Open 7 AM – 9 PM Saturdays.
• The resort only has a small, pricey convenience shop.
• For 4 nights: breakfasts (cereal, milk, yogurt, bread, eggs, fruit), picnic lunches for the 4WD days, snacks, 20+ L of water, drinks.
• Tue Dec 21 BBQ dinner: sausages/steak, rolls, salad (free resort barbecues).
• Pack the cooler last with ice.
blocks.notes:
• ~AUD 250 — estimated.
• = USD ~163.

blocks.title: Drive to the Micat ferry terminal, Port of Brisbane
blocks.detail:
• To: 14 Howard Smith Drive, Port of Brisbane (Fisherman Islands).
• ~35 km via the Gateway Motorway and Gateway Bridge, then the Port of Brisbane Motorway; ~40 min.
• Gates open 1 hr before departure (11:30 AM).
blocks.notes: • Gateway Bridge toll ~AUD 6 — estimated; billed via the rental.

blocks.title: Micat check-in — stay in the vehicle
blocks.detail:
• A crew member comes to the car to check you in.
• Bathroom stop at the terminal before boarding.

blocks.title: Micat vehicle ferry — Port of Brisbane → Moreton Island
blocks.detail:
• Departs 12:30 PM, arrives ~2:00 PM (90 min).
• Lands on the beach at the Tangalooma Wrecks, ~2 km north of the resort.
• Saturday sailings in Dec 2026 ran at 8:00 AM and 12:30 PM.
blocks.notes:
• Quoted on the Micat booking site (Nov 6, 2026) for 1 vehicle + 2 adults + 2 children, Dec 2026 stand-in dates: AUD 243–284 one way to the island → modeled AUD 284 for a Saturday = USD ~185.
• Prices are dynamic and include passengers (driver included).
• A 5.15% fuel levy applies to new bookings.
blocks.flag: Book as soon as Dec 2027 sailings open — both Saturday sailings on Dec 19, 2026 had already sold out of vehicle space.

blocks.title: Drive off at the Wrecks → resort northern car park
blocks.detail:
• Engage 4WD; lower tyre pressure as Wongai shows you.
• ~5 min south to the Tangalooma Island Resort northern car park (official guests only).
• No driving on the beach in front of the resort — use the bypass.
• Tide: Tangalooma high water ~12:39 PM, low ~7:28 PM — the short beach stretch is fine.
blocks.notes:
TIDES — official 2027 predictions (Maritime Safety Queensland, Queensland Tide Tables 2027, Brisbane Bar):
• Tangalooma (west beach): high water 23 min earlier, low water 27 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Ocean beaches (east side, Cape Moreton): 1 hr 30 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Queensland Parks: drive beaches around low tide; avoid 2 hrs either side of high tide.

blocks.title: Check in — Tangalooma Island Resort, 1-bedroom Family Suite
blocks.detail:
• Reception in the Resort Centre.
• Family Suite: 1 bedroom + large living area + kitchenette; sleeps up to 6; includes wild dolphin feeding.
• Register for tonight's dolphin feeding at The Eco Centre (registration 1–4 PM).
• Free beach towels from Reception (refundable deposit).
blocks.notes:
• AUD 1,796 for 4 nights (AUD 449/night) — verified on the resort's booking site for Dec 6–10, 2027 (furthest dates bookable, 2 adults + 2 kids).
• = USD ~1,167. Dec 18–22 is Queensland school holidays — expect higher.
• Check-out is strictly 10:00 AM.
• Car parks can be some distance from the room — no porter from the car park.
blocks.flag: Dec 18–22, 2026 is already sold out for 4 guests. Booking for Dec 2027 opens ~Nov 18, 2026 (399 days ahead) — book that day.

blocks.title: Unload groceries, settle into the suite
blocks.detail: • Cooler contents into the fridge; swimsuits on.

blocks.title: Swim at the resort beach (Moreton Bay side)
blocks.detail:
• Calm, west-facing bay beach in front of the resort.
• No lifeguards anywhere on the island — stay with the kids in the water.
• Water is ~77°F in December.
blocks.flag: Queensland Parks: no patrolled swimming areas on Moreton Island.

blocks.title: Kookaburra feeding (free)
blocks.detail:
• Daily 4:45 PM outside the Deep Blue Apartments, run by the Eco Centre rangers.
• No booking needed.

blocks.title: Dinner — Beach BBQ (bistro on the beach)
blocks.detail:
• Overlooks Moreton Bay; open 5:00–8:30 PM (closed Mon & Tue).
• Kids' meals come with chips and salad.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Jun 2026):
• Chicken parmigiana AUD 31 + Humpty Doo barramundi AUD 38.50
• 2 kids' meals (minute steak / chicken schnitzel) AUD 16 each
• = AUD 101.50 ≈ USD 66.
• No weekend surcharge (15% on public holidays only).
• Prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Back to the suite — get ready for the dolphins
blocks.detail:
• Wear clothes that can get wet up to the waist.
• No sunscreen, insect repellent or perfume on hands/legs; remove rings and watches.

blocks.title: Wild dolphin feeding at the jetty
blocks.detail:
• Near sunset (time posted daily; 6:30 PM in mid-November).
• Hand-feed a wild bottlenose dolphin, once per person per stay — doing it the first night leaves the other nights as backup.
• Kids 102 cm (3'4") and taller walk in with a parent; shorter kids are carried.
• ~99% dolphin attendance.
blocks.notes:
• Included with the Family Suite rate (verified).
• Waders can be hired for AUD 15 if you want to stay dry.

blocks.title: Back to the suite — bed
blocks.detail: • Big snorkel morning tomorrow.

days.title: Snorkel the Tangalooma Wrecks, beach, sand tobogganing at The Desert

blocks.title: Breakfast in the suite
blocks.detail: • From the groceries.

blocks.title: Pool and easy morning
blocks.detail: • Resort pools; sunscreen on before 9.

blocks.title: Walk to Tangatours (next to Fire & Stone)
blocks.detail: • Check in for the snorkel tour.

blocks.title: Snorkel the Tangalooma Wrecks — guided tour
blocks.detail:
• Boat out to the 15 sunken ships; ~30–35 min in the water.
• All gear included: wetsuits, fins, mask, snorkel, life jackets, pool noodles, prescription masks.
• Minimum age 6.
blocks.notes:
• AUD 69 per person × 4 = AUD 276 (verified, resort site).
• = USD ~179. AUD 207 for 3 if Chloe sits out.
blocks.flag: If Chloe is still 5, she can't do it — swap the family onto the 2:15 PM glass-bottom Wrecks fish-feeding cruise (AUD 159 family).

blocks.title: Lunch — The Beach Café
blocks.detail: • Beachfront, casual; open 11:30 AM – 3:30 PM for lunch.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Jul 2026):
• Tanga beef burger AUD 24.50 + fish & chips AUD 19.50
• Kids' cheeseburger & chips AUD 17 + kids' spaghetti bolognese AUD 14
• = AUD 75 ≈ USD 49.
• Prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Quiet time in the suite
blocks.detail: • Midday UV is extreme — stay inside.

blocks.title: Drive to The Desert car park
blocks.detail: • Inland tracks only — no tide issue: Tangalooma Bypass → The Desert Road, ~5 km, 15 min at 30 km/h.

blocks.title: The Desert — sand tobogganing at golden hour
blocks.detail:
• Moreton's giant sand blow, a popular tobogganing spot (Queensland Parks).
• Late afternoon: the sand is cooler and the light is pink.
• Ride lying on your stomach; little ones start partway up.
blocks.notes: • Free — your own boards from BCF.

blocks.title: Dinner — Fire & Stone (Asian, shared plates)
blocks.detail:
• Sichuan and broader Asian; dishes come out to share as they're ready.
• Bookings preferred: (07) 3410 6791. Open 5:00–8:30 PM.
• Kids' meals: chicken nuggets, sweet-chili chicken tenders or fish, each with chips.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (2026):
• Honey chicken AUD 39 + Mongolian beef AUD 39 + special fried rice AUD 30 to share
• Kids' nuggets & chips AUD 20 + sweet-chili tenders & chips AUD 20
• = AUD 148 ≈ USD 96.
• Prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

blocks.title: Watch the dolphins from the jetty
blocks.detail: • Viewing is free for resort guests every night (feeding is once per stay).

days.title: Mount Tempest lookout, Marine Discovery Cruise, easy afternoon

blocks.title: Buffet breakfast — Tursiops
blocks.detail: • Hot buffet (eggs, bacon, sausages, hash browns) + fruit, cereal, coffee, juice. 7:00–9:30 AM weekdays.
blocks.notes: • Adult AUD 38–39, child AUD 27–28 (verified, resort site) → modeled 2 × 39 + 2 × 28 = AUD 134 ≈ USD 87.

blocks.title: Drive to Mount Tempest car park
blocks.detail:
• Inland: Middle Road 6 km from the west beach, then Mount Tempest Road 2.4 km (Queensland Parks).
• Sand tracks at 30 km/h; ~30 min.

blocks.title: Mount Tempest lookout walk
blocks.detail:
• 2.2 km return, steep stairs to the island's high point; views over both coasts.
• Go early — little shade.
• Water bottles and hats.

blocks.title: Marine Discovery Cruise — dugongs, turtles, dolphins
blocks.detail:
• 90 min along the marine park coast past the Wrecks and WWII bunkers.
• Looks for turtles, dugongs, dolphins, rays; all ages.
• Doesn't run in poor or windy weather.
blocks.notes:
• Family (2 adults + 2 kids) AUD 225 (resort site; listed prices were valid to Mar 31, 2026 — re-check).
• = USD ~146.

blocks.title: Late lunch in the suite
blocks.detail: • From the groceries.

blocks.title: Sunset swim at the resort beach
blocks.detail: • West-facing beach — sunset over the bay ~6:45 PM.

blocks.title: Dinner — The Beach Café
blocks.detail:
• Beach BBQ is closed Mondays.
• Open 5:00–9:00 PM for dinner.
blocks.notes:
PRICED FROM THE CURRENT MENU (Jul 2026):
• Grilled lemon thyme chicken AUD 32 + pepperoni pizza AUD 29
• Kids' fish & chips AUD 16 + chicken tenders & chips AUD 14.50
• = AUD 91.50 ≈ USD 59.
• Prices include 10% GST; tipping isn't expected.

days.title: 4WD the south end — Big Sandhills, Mirapool, Rous Battery; BBQ night

blocks.title: Breakfast in the suite; pack the picnic
blocks.detail: • Cooler with ice, water, snacks, boards in the car.

blocks.title: Walk to the car park, load up
West beach south → Big Sandhills
blocks.detail:
• Tangalooma Bypass 1 km to the west beach just south of the resort, then 11.5 km south (Queensland Parks route).
• Tide: Tangalooma low water 9:15 AM — ideal.
• Beach speed limit 60 km/h; slow near people.
blocks.notes:
TIDES — official 2027 predictions (Maritime Safety Queensland, Queensland Tide Tables 2027, Brisbane Bar):
• Tangalooma (west beach): high water 23 min earlier, low water 27 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Ocean beaches (east side, Cape Moreton): 1 hr 30 min earlier than Brisbane Bar.
• Queensland Parks: drive beaches around low tide; avoid 2 hrs either side of high tide.

Today (Tangalooma): low 9:15 AM, high 3:18 PM. Ocean beach: low 8:12 AM, high 2:11 PM → off the east beach by 12:11 PM.
blocks.flag: Queensland Parks: the west beach between Tangalooma and Kooringal is not always passable even at low tide — ask Wongai/rangers about current conditions.

blocks.title: Big Sandhills — tobogganing on the biggest dunes
blocks.detail:
• Steepest dunes on the island; go early before the sand heats up.
• Stay off the vegetation; walk up the open sand only.

blocks.title: Little Sandhills (2 km further south)
blocks.detail: • Quick stop and photos.

blocks.title: Kooringal → Mirapool bypass
blocks.detail:
• Before Kooringal turn onto the Kooringal–Mirapool Road (2 km), then the Mirapool Bypass Track (1.3 km).
• Beach at Mirapool is closed to vehicles 3 hrs either side of high tide — use the bypass.

blocks.title: Mirapool Lagoon
blocks.detail: • Shorebird sanctuary — look, no swimming (prohibited).

blocks.title: East beach north → Rous Battery
blocks.detail: • 7.5 km north on the ocean beach.

blocks.title: Rous Battery — WWII gun emplacements
blocks.detail: • Short walk around the fort remains; supervise kids around the relics.

blocks.title: East beach north → Middle Road
blocks.detail: • 11.6 km; off the beach before 12:11 PM (2 hrs before the 2:11 PM ocean high tide).

blocks.title: Middle Road west → resort
blocks.detail: • ~6 km inland at 30 km/h.

blocks.title: Picnic lunch
